headline: Passed an order authorizing a motor vehicle transfer agreement 5-0 and referred it to the full Council.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, 
CONNECTICUT 
 
PUBLIC SAFETY 
COMMITTEE 
 
MINUTES DRAFT 
 
 
Committee Chair: 
Present - Adrian Webber 
Committee Vice Chair: 
Present - Tasha Hunt 
Committee Members: 
Present - Sean Cardwell 
Present - Maurine Crouch 
Present - Tom Figlar 
Absent - Sarah Gallagher, Majority Leader 
Absent - Bob Anthony, Minority Leader 
Present - Katie Kiely, President 
 
1. CALL OF THE MEETING AND TAKING OF THE ROLL 
Public Safety Committee Meeting October 19, 2026, 7:00pm.  Vice Chair Hunt called the 
meeting to order at 7:18pm.  President Kiely called the roll, and the above members were 
present.  
2. PUBLIC INPUT SESSION 
No one came forward to give public comment. The Public Input session was closed at 
7:19pm.   
3. REPORT OF DEPARTMENTS, BOARDS, AND COMMISSIONS 
Vice Chair Hunt noted the upcoming Boards/Commission meetings that fall under the 
Committee.   
4. REGULAR AGENDA  
  
 
1. ORDER AUTHORIZING A MOTOR VEHICLE TRANSFER AGREEMENT 
Motion to Open: Council member Figlar; Second: Pro Tem Cardwell 
Vote: 5 in favor, 0 opposed; 0 abstentions.  Item passed unanimously.   
 
President Kiely invited the Committee Vice Chair to refer the item to the full Council for 
vote this evening.   
Vice Chair Hunt called for motion to refer the item.  The motion was made by Council 
member Figlar and seconded by Pro Tem Cardwell. 
Vote: 5 in favor, 0 opposed, 0 abstentions.  The motion to refer the item to the full 
Council passed unanimously.  
  
5. NEW COMMITTEE BUSINESS 
There was no new business for this evening’s meeting. 
  
6. UNFINISHED COMMITTEE BUSINESS 
There was no unfinished business for this evening’s meeting.  
7 . ADJOURN 
Prior to adjourning, Vice Chair Hunt thanked the Hamden Police Department for the Back to 
School Carnival.  She noted that it was an awesome and successful event and a wonderful 
opportunity for the town residents to come out and have fun. 
 
 Vice Chair Hunt adjourned the meeting at 7:29pm.
